work_item: Independent semantic review of Runtime11 native contextual guidance

rows.note: Clearly distinguishes flattened visible pixels from separate editable layers.
Correctly says flattened pixels cannot reconstruct original layers and points to a layered project/PSD.
Gives a concrete filter workflow and identifies the Full editor prerequisite.
Provides a direct Numbers-layer search/select/visibility workflow.
Maps Clearcoat to B, Metalness to R, Roughness to G, and states they are separate; no changes.
Correctly distinguishes Clearcoat/B from blue paint and the other spec channels.
Confirms the built-in helper works without a key, but mostly gives provider setup instead of a useful inventory of offline capabilities.
Directly says supported built-in finish changes require neither provider key nor paid model call.
Tells the user to keep Solid mode/current value and change only finish; explicitly avoids Source Paint.
Correctly advises against switching to Source Paint when retaining authored Solid color.
Gives the Full editor toolbar/history and AI-answer Undo controls.
Explains mask conflict preservation/refusal and limits the claim to safe AI-owned values, not a full-project restore.
No current receipt is present in this fixture; it correctly refuses to infer a change from a draft.
Describes Easy-mode color/finish selection but does not explain how to inspect the helper's proposed target before application.
Does not promise complete logo detection and directs the user to inspect and confirm candidates.
Explicitly says remembered number location from another paint is not confirmation for the current paint.
Explains Save/Open, retained layer state/pixel payload, source path, and PSD/adjustment-layer limits.
Accurately limits automatic tracing and describes importing/moving/scaling/rotating an image layer.
Safely distinguishes current authored Solid from Source Paint, but does not explain what matte means; no mutation occurred.
Explicitly says nothing changed and preserves ownership guards, but does not explain the likely chrome effect requested.
Gives Save/Open steps and accurately states that current layer payload is saved while original PSD bytes are not bundled.
With no current verified receipt, it says it will not guess whether a change applied.
Accurately describes saved zones/layer pixel payload, source path, and PSD adjustment-semantic limits.
Gives direct Undo and Undo History navigation.
Correctly preserves current authored Solid color while changing finish only.
Confirms no action occurred but postpones the requested explanation to another turn.
Correctly says a suggestion is not proof and requires a current verified receipt.
Distinguishes suggestion/preview from applied change and honestly reports no matching receipt.
Matches W117: identifies Clearcoat(B), separates it from paint hue, and says Roughness(G) remains unchanged.
After Undo leaves no current verified receipt, it declines to claim a completed change.

material_findings: No misleading application claim was found; all 30 recorded answers have queueLength 0.

The sole failure is preview-target: its answer still does not tell the user how to inspect the proposed helper area before applying. This is a usability/coverage gap, not an unsafe mutation in this run.
The matte and chrome hypotheticals remain read-only and safe, but their effect explanations are incomplete.
limits: Grades are semantic review of this exact 30-answer native artifact against the W82/W117 meanings; wording need not match those reports verbatim.
Snapshot booleans are reported from the artifact and are reserved for root's independent verification; this review did not perform native actions.
No provider or native calls were made during review.
